maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from licensing in-car voice AI software to automakers for new vehicles, not from servicing installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private automakers and Tier-1 suppliers; consumers ultimately pay through vehicle purchases.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by licensing its own voice and AI platform to automakers, not through a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Voice assistant is embedded and validated in vehicle platforms; automakers face re-integration, qualification and long design-cycle costs to switch.
